doc.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: George Wallington offers an introduction to Prestige
summary: Allison brought his pieces when Wallington offered to introduce him to Bob Weinstock.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: However, in one of the interviews I read on the Internet, you stated that when the
opportunity to came to do your first recording, George Wallington, the distinguished pianist from New York, offered to introduce you to Bob Weinstock from Prestige Records...

...and you had these pieces. You said, “I have something for him; I can give him this stuff.” You’d been writing them over the intervening time between reading Collingwood and starting to crystallize these ideas. This is the reason why I’m mentioning these things now.
